_comment: IteratedMatchingPennies locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is; do not translate the move tokens [heads]/[tails]/[h]/[t].

_slots.{role}: The player's rendered role name (Matcher / Mismatcher)
_slots.{p0_choice}: Player 0's move token, 'heads' or 'tails' (do not translate)
_slots.{p1_choice}: Player 1's move token, 'heads' or 'tails' (do not translate)

player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} ({role}) in a {num_rounds}-round Matching Pennies game.
- Each round, submit [heads] or [tails] (or [h], [t]).
- If your choice matches your opponent’s, Player 0 wins the round; otherwise Player 1 wins.
Reply with your choice in the format '[heads]' or '[tails]'.
